scope: Missing37 membership candidate files, three offline native verification tools and protected recovery host composition for the current five clubs. Existing membership backend/route selection is coordinated separately.
status: local native integration implemented; device/provider/store acceptance open
technical_decisions: Keep existing Supabase paid membership flow; NativeMembershipApi injection makes backend choice explicit and prevents passing Supabase JWT into Cloudflare native token port.
Account/club scope is checked before storage/backend work. Session rotation and background/logout fence in-flight replies; after a sent write a lost identity recheck is unknown.
Persist exact original checkout/handoff identifiers; lifecycle events never clear markers, create a replacement key, retry automatically or launch an external app.
Android uses app-private noBackupFilesDir and Keystore AES-256-GCM; no new SMS/CALL_PHONE permissions. Below API26 recovery fails closed without raising unrelated app minSdk.
iOS uses WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly/non-sync Keychain and a protected excluded-from-backup installation anchor; mismatched, weak or ambiguous legacy state blocks recovery.
Registration enables protected storage capability only. Dart native checkout remains disabled unless the explicit composition selects it.
The imported dated source-provenance record remains historical evidence; only this report records the current archive/member/hash checks.

remaining_acceptance: Actual protected credential supply and frontend/backend selection with accessible reviewed confirmation must be validated in the composed supporter journey.

Real Android Keystore and iOS Keychain tests, device lock/unlock/reboot/process kill/power interruption/low storage/multi-engine/disposal, encrypted storage policy and exact uncertain recovery semantics.
Signed five-club full builds and physical-device dialer/network behavior, accessibility and existing paid-membership journey acceptance.
Reinstall, app-data clearing, restore/rollback and server-authoritative reconciliation; absence of both local halves cannot distinguish new install from lost unresolved state.
Capacity/retention/erasure/compaction/key-rotation/lost-state operational design; the local store never evicts pending markers.
Provider reconciliation, deployed backend/auth and store/legal/release acceptance; no provider, signing, deployment or store action was performed.
